- Súmula 555: no declaration of debt → Article 173 I.
- Tema 163: partial payment → Article 150 §4º (5 years from the taxable event); no payment → Article 173 I.
- CTN Article 174: statute of limitations for collection runs 5 years from final assessment — irrelevant here (assessment was in 2026).

Assumption (to be stated explicitly): for quarterly real-profit IRPJ/CSLL, the taxable event occurs at the end of the assessment period (quarter end). The library does not contain a provision fixing this date; it is a general premise derived from the concept of "período de apuração" — label it as an assumption/undeclared premise.
